text: dopo Il dispacsio fato li uoce Sieri Io riceuuti
note: dispacsio: 6th letter a long-s/sigma-like form (s, or ch/c); uoce: last letter has an x-like stroke through it, possibly struck out; Sieri and Seri: first letter S or h (hieri/heri?); Io: capital I like an E

text: lle di monsiur sillerye quali li mando che la leuata
note: lle: first word, faint, under first cipher sign; sillerye: y or i before final e

text: desuizzeri non e pronta che mi fa risolur partirsabato
note: partirsabato written as one word; risolur as written

text: prossimo con quanto Io qa qtto che mi preme si sono
note: qa: q with a raised a well after it (an abbreviation, left unexpanded); qtto: first letter q or g, reads like neither otto nor tutto cleanly

text: suor Caualli et denari si che la suplico mandar bona scorta
note: suor as written (a dot before Caualli); che: written like Ee, read as the ch ligature

text: su la strada tra R?alom pouge che mi troue ranno m
note: R?alom: second letter c, e or i (Rcalom/Realom/Rialom), last letter m with flourish; pouge doubtful (pouge/pouigi); mi written as four minims without dot (nn?); ranno: minim count unclear (rannno?); final m isolated, perhaps abbreviation
2: numeral written z-like with a stroke, could be 2 or 22/25; ottbre as written (abbreviated month)
